data.title: 刻俄柏 · 厨房门后的蜜饼偷吃倒计时
data.action: 蹲在厨房储藏柜阴影下，双手捧着咬了一大口的蜂蜜饼，狗耳朵因警惕而竖得笔直，看见博士走来慌忙把蜜饼藏在身后咧嘴傻笑
data.location: 罗德岛生活区大厨房储藏柜阴影下
data.lighting: 冰箱微启时流淌出的幽冷白光，照亮少女嘴角残留的蜂蜜渣与警惕晃动的大耳朵
data.mood: 憨萌单纯、活泼贪吃、毫无心机的可爱本能
data.description: 罗德岛深夜空无一人的主厨房。刻俄柏只穿着一件印满小狗爪印的明黄纯棉运动背心和短裤，赤着脚丫蹑手蹑脚地摸进了饼干储藏室。她蹲在木柜角落，嘴里塞满了甜滋滋的刚出炉蜂蜜饼。听到脚步声，两只佩洛兽耳猛然警觉竖起，当看清是博士后，她连忙把剩下的大半块蜜饼背到身后，嘴里鼓鼓囊囊地发出含糊的傻笑——「唔……博、博士！小刻没有偷吃！小刻是在帮厨房……消灭坏掉的甜饼！真的好吃，要分博士一半吗？」
data.promptProse: Ceobe is caught red-handed during a midnight raid on the Rhodes Island kitchen pantry, squatting barefoot beside a wooden barrel in a sunny-yellow paw-print cotton tank top and grey drawstring sleep shorts. Caught with honey biscuit crumbs around her mouth, she grins sheepishly into the crisp white light spilling from an open refrigerator door.
data.animaCaption: Squatting barefoot behind a pantry barrel in a yellow paw-print cotton tank top and grey drawstring sleep shorts, she hides a half-eaten honey biscuit behind her back with crumbs on her cheek and a guilty grin. Cold white light from the cracked refrigerator cuts across the dark kitchen floor.
data.nsfwProse: She wears a sunny-yellow ribbed cotton tank top printed with puppy paw motifs and soft charcoal-grey drawstring athletic sleep shorts.
